description: This file defines an internal interface 'IPubSubRendezvousGrain' for pub/sub rendezvous operations within Orleans streaming infrastructure, including methods for registering/unregistering producers and consumers, counting, diagnostics, and fault handling.

classes.name: IPubSubRendezvousGrain
classes.description: An internal interface for pub/sub rendezvous grain operations, extending IGrainWithStringKey, providing methods for managing producers and consumers in Orleans streaming.

methods.name: RegisterProducer
methods.description: Registers a producer for a specific stream identified by streamId.

methods.name: UnregisterProducer
methods.description: Unregisters a producer from a specific stream.

methods.name: RegisterConsumer
methods.description: Registers a consumer with a subscription ID, stream ID, and optional filter data.

methods.name: UnregisterConsumer
methods.description: Unregisters a consumer from a specific stream.

methods.name: ProducerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of producers for a given stream.

methods.name: ConsumerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of consumers for a given stream.

methods.name: DiagGetConsumers
methods.description: Retrieves the list of consumers for a stream for diagnostic purposes.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Performs validation of the rendezvous state.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Gets all subscriptions for a stream, optionally filtered by consumer.

methods.name: FaultSubscription
methods.description: Faults a subscription identified by subscription ID.
